name: SMC-CFG (unit-norm, x0 space)
plain: Treats guidance as a control problem: a sliding surface built from current and previous guidance error adds a correction before CFG. This version replaces sign with a unit-norm vector because the author says sign did not work.
math:
e = x̂_c − x̂_u; ẽ = stored (first: e)
S = (e − ẽ) + λ·ẽ
Δ = −k·S/‖S‖₂
e' = e + Δ; store e' (the corrected value)
x̂ = x̂_u + s·e'
label: from code
surprise: Stores corrected error, while ethanfel explicitly stores raw error to avoid accumulation.
